annotations.title: DBA check: does a freelance assignment look like employment?

description: Indicates whether a Dutch freelance (ZZP) assignment risks being treated as disguised employment (schijnzelfstandigheid) under the DBA rules the Belastingdienst enforces again since 2025: authority, integration in the organisation, personal work and pay, and acting as an entrepreneur. Answer each question yes, partly or no; at least 4. An indication only; the official check is the Belastingdienst Webmodule Beoordeling Arbeidsrelatie.

clientCarriesRisk.description: If something goes wrong, does the client carry the cost instead of the freelancer?

coreWork.description: Is the work part of the client's normal, ongoing business?

howWhenWhere.description: Does the client decide how, when and where the work is done?

investsOwnMeans.description: Does the freelancer pay for their own tools, training, insurance and marketing?

longAssignment.description: Has the assignment lasted more than a year, or does it have no clear end?

looksLikeStaff.description: Does the freelancer work like staff, with the client's email address, badge or a place in a team?

mustDoPersonally.description: Must the freelancer do the work personally, without being able to send a replacement?

paidForTime.description: Is the pay per hour or per month, whatever the result?

sameInstructions.description: Does the freelancer get the same instructions as employees doing the same work?

setsHours.description: Does the client set the hours or days worked?

setsOwnRate.description: Does the freelancer set and negotiate their own rate?

severalClients.description: Does the freelancer work for several clients, with no single client giving most of the income?
